3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: The city had been of particular importance to the Bludish people ever since the Izzam Incident and the death of Watani Aschraf over two decades ago. Today, we were here to commemorate the anniversary of those events.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: Our massive convoy could barely fit through the narrow streets, disrupting local traffic and creating noisy chaos in the usually tranquil city. Pedestrians stared at us in fear as we and our heavily armed security forces drove towards the square.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Our convoy could barely fit through the narrow streets, disrupting local traffic and creating noisy chaos in the usually tranquil city. Pedestrians stared at us with concern as we and our security forces drove towards the square.

10.speaker: Lucian Galade
10.text: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. This will help ease the tensions. But I hope bringing this much security won't cause any problems.”

15.speaker: Lucian Galade
15.text: “It is certainly risky. But if we manage to win some hearts today, it will be worth it.”

16.speaker: Lucian Galade
16.text: “If we play our cards right, I am certain.”

18.speaker: Lucian Galade
18.text: “We are almost there. I can hear the crowd.”

22.speaker: Lucian Galade
22.text: “They are telling us to go back where we came from.”

23.speaker: Narrator
23.text: I heard the chants and shouting from outside. Lucian leaned closer to the window, listening to their voices.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: I heard the chants and shouting from the outside. Lucian leaned closer to the window, listening to their voices.

25.speaker: Lucian Galade
25.text: “They seem to be chanting 'Yollak Bluderat'. I believe that means 'Free Bludia' in Bludish, or something of that sort.”

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people. Most of them were yelling insults and obscenities at me. I heard a few shouts of "Soll's boot licker!"

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people.

28.speaker: Narrator
28.text: As our convoy slowed down, a young Bludish man ran in front of our vehicle and spat on my window.

29.speaker: Lucian Galade
29.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: Our vehicle came to a stop.

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: The security detail left their vehicles with their machine guns openly displayed. I followed them. The crowd seemed to be riled up at the sight of guns.
34.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

35.speaker: Narrator
35.text: My driver exited the vehicle and opened the door for me.
35.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false)

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: We were greeted by Mansoun Leke. He wore a coat over his suit which was marked with the red and turquoise stripes of the Bludish movement's flag. He moved forward to greet us.
36.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.BergiaSpecialZone_Proposal_Centralization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Policy_Law_Ban_WPB"] == true) == false)

40.speaker: Player
40.text: “No need for pleasantries. I want this over with as quickly as possible.”

41.speaker: Player
41.text: “It looks like I am not welcome here, Mr. Leke.”

42.speaker: Mansoun Leke
42.text: “Very perceptive of you. But that is why you are here, if I am correct. To fix this.”

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: He pointed at the security guards with guns.

47.speaker: Mansoun Leke
47.text: “I am not sure how bringing your personal army will help.”

49.speaker: Player
49.text: “They are not my personal army. They protect the government.”

51.speaker: Mansoun Leke
51.text: “Protection from your own citizens? I guess there must be a reason to be fearful.”

53.speaker: Player_Italic
53.text: Take his hand and raise it in a display of unity.

57.speaker: Narrator
57.text: I heard shouts in Bludish coming from the crowd.

58.speaker: Narrator
58.text: I heard some applause from the crowd.

59.speaker: Mansoun Leke
59.text: “I see. The government must have a reason to fear its own citizens then.”

60.speaker: Mansoun Leke
60.text: “On a day like this, when you want to show support for the murdered Bludish people... You bring men with guns.”

61.speaker: Mansoun Leke
61.text: “Mr. Galade. Welcome. Shall we move on to the Sanctuary, then?”

63.speaker: Narrator
63.text: We made our way to the Erzaren Sanctuary, which stood at the end of the square.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: A much smaller replica of the Archsanctuary in Deyr, the ancient building had a mystical aura emanting from its blackened walls. We entered the building through the ornamented large metal gates.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: As we walked, the noise of the crowd faded out. Everyone fell silent for the ceremony. Thousands of candles were burning inside the Sanctuary, one for each person that died in Izzam. The red candle in the center was for Watani Aschraf.

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: He also picked up a candle and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: He picked up the candle for Aschraf and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: He picked up the candle for Aschraf and started walking out. Many others followed suit, including us.

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: The atmosphere outside had completely changed. Not a single noise came from the crowd.

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: We slowly walked towards Aschraf's grave. On the way, hundreds of people joined us.

83.speaker: Narrator
83.text: Seeing the red candle in my hand, some people started shouting at me, breaking the silence. One man managed to break the security cordon and ran towards me, screaming.
83.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bludish_Opinion"] <= 0  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true)

84.speaker: Narrator
84.text: When we arrived, he pointed at a huge standing torch above the grave.
84.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_RegularCandle"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bludish_Opinion"] <= 0  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_RegularCandle"] == true)

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: When we arrived, Mansoun lit the unlit candle above the grave.
85.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_RegularCandle"] == true) and (Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Bludish_Opinion"] <= 0  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Arrest_FetihEjall"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_AschrafCandle"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_RegularCandle"] == true) == false)

87.speaker: Player_Italic
87.text: Light the torch together with Mansoun.

88.speaker: Narrator
88.text: I turned around and realized the sheer amount of people who were following us. They were all looking at me, waiting to hear what I would say.

91.speaker: Player
91.text: “We are here to mourn Watani Aschraf and many others who have lost their lives.”

93.speaker: Player
93.text: “Let me tell you one thing. I dream of a truly united Sordland. A country where being a Blud or a Sord does not matter.”

94.speaker: Player_Italic
94.text: Signal the security to detain him.

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: Seeing the boy get dragged away caused an outcry from the crowd. Hundreds of people rushed at our car.

97.speaker: Player
97.text: “They were brave men and women who only wanted to protect their land.”

98.speaker: Player
98.text: “I am not standing before you today as the President. I am standing here as one of you.”

99.speaker: Player
99.text: “I condemn the events that led to the loss of these lives.”

100.speaker: Player
100.text: “I share your hatred and anger. I feel it too, I assure you. Like a red-hot iron, it takes a long time for it to cool. But I look at the lost lives and think, what would they want?”

101.speaker: Player
101.text: “I assure you, this administration will do its absolute best to mend the wounds.”

102.speaker: Player
102.text: “Despite attempts to divide us, our people will stand as one. We are Sord. We are Blud. We are all united under one flag.”

103.speaker: Player
103.text: “We are all the same before God. Remember the words: 'Love thy brothers and thy sisters.'”

104.speaker: Player
104.text: “Let this be a testament of our unity for future generations! Let's stand together as Blud and Sord.”

105.speaker: Player
105.text: “I feel responsible and ashamed for the actions of my predecessors. Most of all, I feel the desperation to remove this black mark from our history.”

106.speaker: Player
106.text: “We must always stay together in the face of adversity. Against all odds.”

107.speaker: Player
107.text: “Mistakes were made. The innocent people of Izzam paid the price. But we cannot let the past divide us.”

108.speaker: Player
108.text: “I need help from each and every one of you. To make this country a better place for everyone.”
108.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) == false)

109.speaker: Player
109.text: “The responsibility falls on all of our shoulders. Because we don't have anyone but each other.”
109.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) == false)

112.speaker: Player
112.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_SordlandToday_Bias"] == true) == false)

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: There was no reaction from the crowd. Only silence.

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Your flag! Your nation!"

115.speaker: Narrator
115.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Revenge!"

116.speaker: Narrator
116.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "Bullshit!"

117.speaker: Player
117.text: “Don't play into the hands of the separationists. United we stand. Divided we fall.”

119.speaker: Player
119.text: “To what end? We need to break this vicious cycle of violence and vengeance for a better future.”

122.speaker: Player
122.text: “Despite these kinds of attempts to divide us, we will be united as one. We will work together!”

127.speaker: Narrator
127.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He is right!"

131.speaker: Narrator
131.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He is right!"

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: An old man from the crowd yelled: "He speaks the truth!"

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Mansoun leaned in closer to me.

154.speaker: Narrator
154.text: Lucian looked at me worriedly. People started coming closer and closer to us, chanting "Yollak Bluderat."

155.speaker: Narrator
155.text: I was immediately surrounded by the security detail I had brought with me. They had drawn their guns and were pointing them at the approaching crowd.
155.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Unrest_BFF_WillHappen"] == true)

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: There was the deafening noise of machine gun fire. I closed my eyes.

158.speaker: Narrator
158.text: Everything became a blur. The guards circled around me, shielding me from the chaos.

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: They escorted me to our vehicle in a matter of seconds. I heard more gunshots as we drove out of Erzaren.

160.speaker: Mansoun Leke
160.text: “I must admit, Mr. President. That was a good speech.”

163.speaker: Player
163.text: “I hope the crowd thinks the same.”

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: He extended his hand to me for a handshake.

167.speaker: Mansoun Leke
167.text: “Thank you for this, Mr. President. I don't think the people of Erzaren will ever forget this.”

168.speaker: Mansoun Leke
168.text: “You have become the first and only president brave enough to come to Erzaren and pay respects to the Izzam victims. I hope this will be the start of a new era.”

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: We started making our way back to the convoy.

172.speaker: Lucian Galade
172.text: “Well done, sir. This will prove very useful in the upcoming elections.”

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: We entered our vehicles and started making our way back home from Erzaren.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Unrest_BFF_WillHappen"] == true) == false)

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: With only our personal guards protecting us against a crowd of thousands, we starting making our way back to the cars hastily.

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: The convoy started driving away as soon as we were seated. The windows of the vehicles were completely covered with rotten vegetables, eggs and splatters of paint by the time we finally left the city.

185.speaker: Lucian Galade
185.text: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. This will help ease tensions.”

186.speaker: Player
186.text: “Yes. But I am still worried about our safety.”

187.speaker: Narrator
187.text: We entered the historic center wearing flak vests, transported by an armored personnel carrier. I gazed out its windows at the city's rundown buildings.

191.speaker: Narrator
191.text: There was an outcry from the crowd. Hundreds of people shouted slurs at us while keeping their distance. The heavy weaponry that the security carried seemed to have startled them.

192.speaker: Narrator
192.text: The ceremonies were to be held in the aptly named Izzam Square, several blocks away from Lake Soll and the sunken ruins of the village of Izzam.

193.speaker: Narrator
193.text: We entered the historic center in the presidential Kadilla. The streets were littered with broken glass and the walls defaced with graffiti. I sensed a heavy regional police presence.

194.speaker: Narrator
194.text: The local police forces did their best to calm the angry crowd and pushed them away from our vehicle. I suddenly had the feeling that our forces were in danger of being overwhelmed.

195.speaker: Narrator
195.text: After a few hours' drive, we finally arrived in the ancient walled city of Erzaren.

199.speaker: Lucian Galade
199.text: “They seem to be chanting your name, sir. I believe they are happy with their new autonomy.”

203.speaker: Narrator
203.text: The crowd before me had signs in their hands protesting my decision to centralize Bergia.

207.speaker: Mansoun Leke
207.text: “Very perceptive of you. I wonder why that is the case...”

209.speaker: Lucian Galade

239.speaker: Narrator
239.text: Mansoun looked at me with a mix of fear and anger in his eyes, but he knew better than to speak.

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: We entered the historic center wearing flak vests, transported by an armored personnel carrier. The streets were littered with broken glass and the walls defaced with graffiti. I sensed a heavy regional police presence.

248.speaker: Narrator
248.text: We entered the historic center in the presidential Kadilla. I gazed out its windows at the city's rundown buildings.

252.speaker: Lucian Galade
252.text: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. After giving the Bludish autonomy, this will send a strong message that you are on their side. But I hope bringing this much security won't cause any problems.”

256.speaker: Lucian Galade
256.text: “I must say this was a good decision, sir. After giving the Bludish autonomy, this will send a strong message that you are on their side.”

260.speaker: Narrator
260.text: A large crowd had assembled in the square. There were probably at least ten thousand people. Most of them were yelling insults and obscenities at me.

261.speaker: Mansoun Leke
261.text: “I suppose the governor's huge army wasn't enough. Bergia has already become a police state. A truly *special* zone.”

265.speaker: Mansoun Leke
265.text: “I don't know what your intention is, but I only ask of you to at least be respectful during the ceremony, Mr. President.”

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: He pointed at the gendarmerie forces.
269.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true)

270.speaker: Mansoun Leke
270.text: “I am not sure how bringing your army will help.”

272.speaker: Player
272.text: “They are not my army. They protect the Special Region of Bergia.”

273.speaker: Mansoun Leke
273.text: “The man who abuses his authority to oppress Bergia.”

275.speaker: Player
275.text: “I am supportive of you, Mr. Leke. I want him gone as much as you.”

276.speaker: Player
276.text: “We are trying our best to contain him, but without changing the laws there's nothing I can do about it.”

278.speaker: Player
278.text: “My only intention is to stand in solidarity with our Bludish people.”

280.speaker: Player
280.text: “Watch your words. You are speaking to the president.”

282.speaker: Player_Italic
282.text: Leave the candle next to it.

283.speaker: Player
283.text: “We are here to mourn those who, tragically, lost their lives in Izzam.”

288.speaker: Narrator
288.text: One man broke the silence and shouted "Do not listen to murderers!", and threw a tomato. It hit the ground right in front of me.
288.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGameIsolated.Turn09_A_AschrafAnniversary_CrowdReaction"] > -1  and  Variable["BaseGame.Bludish_Opinion"] > -6) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Media_Censored"] == false) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Unrest_BFF_WillHappen"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Unrest_BFF_WillHappen"] == true) == false)

295.speaker: Narrator
295.text: "Despite ultranationalists, we keep marching!" shouted a group of people in the very front, who also started waving the flags of the Workers Party of Bludia.

299.speaker: Narrator
299.text: "You cannot claim that you support us after trying to kill our language!"

303.speaker: Narrator
303.text: "What were you doing in Wehlen against our people? You are responsible of the deaths of thousands!"

307.speaker: Narrator
307.text: "You supported Murderer Smolak in his crusade against our people! You denied entry to innocent refugees! You are responsible for the deaths of thousands!"
307.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Bill_Turn07_LanguageBill_Signed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_JointOperation"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_DefendBorder"] == true)

308.speaker: Narrator
308.text: There was a moment of complete silence. Then, the whole crowd erupted.

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: I was immediately surrounded by the local police forces. They had drawn their guns and were pointing them at the approaching crowd.
309.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_Bluds"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn05_AutocratEmergency_Extend"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Autocrat_CourtVote_Success"] == true)  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Bron"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Bergia_Governor_Krull"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Decision_Turn08_AschrafSupport_GoWithSecurity"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Unrest_BFF_WillHappen"] == true) == false)

310.speaker: Narrator
310.text: Hearing the chaos, regional police forces and the gendarmerie also rushed to our aid. Suddenly, the entire crowd was surrounded by an army.

311.speaker: Narrator
311.text: As the security forces pushed everyone away, the presidential guard escorted us back to our vehicle.

314.speaker: Player
314.text: “I'm glad I brought this much security.”

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: We entered our vehicles and starting making our way back home from Erzaren.

318.speaker: Narrator
318.text: I turned to follow him. Just then, someone yelled "Yollak Bluderat" and dashed towards us with a knife.

319.speaker: Narrator
319.text: The noise stopped. I gathered up the courage to open my eyes again.

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: The man had fallen to the ground. The crowd panicked and began to scatter.

322.speaker: Narrator
322.text: A woman, probably his mother, fell on her knees right next to him and caressed his head. Her scream pierced the panic.

330.speaker: Mansoun Leke
330.text: “I don't know if any of this really makes a difference after what you have done against the Bludish people.”

331.speaker: Mansoun Leke
331.text: “Still, you came here to Erzaren for the anniversary of the Izzam Incident. That is a good start.”

332.speaker: Lucian Galade
332.text: “The whole trip runs on a schedule, sir. The convoy needs to start driving now, or else we won't make it back in time.”

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: I saw another body on the ground behind him. It was a boy.

352.speaker: Player
352.text: “That boy! Make sure he is okay!”

355.speaker: Player
355.text: “We have to get out of here.”

398.speaker: Narrator
398.text: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the Governor of Bergia, Phelix Bron, to discuss the security situation within the Special Zone. He wished us luck at the event and told us to be careful before bidding us farewell.

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the Governor of Bergia, Herbert Krull, to discuss the security situation within the Special Zone. He wished us luck at the event and told us to be extremely careful before bidding us farewell.

403.speaker: Narrator
403.text: On our way to Erzaren, we stopped in Deyr to meet with the new Governor of Bergia, Ishval Ersen, to discuss the implementation of the autonomous zone. He welcomed us with great sympathy and care, and wished us the best for the event.

404.speaker: Narrator

408.speaker: Narrator
408.text: I saw many signs that condemned the arrest of Fetih Ejall.

433.speaker: Narrator
433.text: Just then, I noticed a few BFF flags waving at the very back of the crowd.

437.speaker: Player
437.text: "There are people in the crowd with BFF flags. I thought security wouldn't allow such a thing."

438.speaker: Player
438.text: "I'm not sure if I should continue with the speech, Lucian. I think we might be in danger."

439.speaker: Player
439.text: "I saw some BFF flags. Could you please check if everything's all right?"

440.speaker: Lucian Galade
440.text: "Are you sure, sir? The police wouldn't have allowed those flags here."

441.speaker: Lucian Galade
441.text: "Are you sure, sir? I can't see anything. The police wouldn't have allowed those flags here."

442.speaker: Lucian Galade
442.text: "Do you want to cancel the speech, sir?"

444.speaker: Player
444.text: "Okay, never mind. I'll continue with the speech."

445.speaker: Player
445.text: "Yes. I want to cancel the speech. Let's leave this place immediately."

449.speaker: Narrator
449.text: We quickly made our way offstage amid surprised looks from the crowd.

450.speaker: Narrator
450.text: A man shouted, "Yes! Run away to your home! Don't ever come back here!" and threw a tomato. It hit the ground right in front of me.

451.speaker: Narrator
451.text: Lucian looked at me worriedly. People started walking closer and closer to us, chanting "Yollak Bluderat."

455.speaker: Narrator
455.text: There was a second of silence. Then, the entire crowd erupted.

456.speaker: Narrator
456.text: "Despite ultranationalists, we keep marching!" shouted a group of people in the very front, wielding the flags of the Workers Party of Bludia.
